title: Observe a dependency failure without forcing installation
goal: Demonstrate strict local rpm dependency checking and leave unrelated state intact.
challenge: With both fixtures absent, inspect report 1.0-1’s exact data dependency; retain both the root-context --test refusal and actual refused install using only the protected report archive. Preview, but do not apply, the compatible pair. Compare final full package state; never use force or nodeps.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/rpm-dependencies.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/rpm-dependencies.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here || return 19; test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; cfg() { case "$1" in /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave) ;; *) return 19;; esac; here && test "$(realpath -e /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = /etc/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = root:root:755 && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$1")" = root:root:644:1; }; keepcfg() { cfg "$1" && fresh "$w/$2" && cp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1; }; releasecfg() { cfg "$1" && test "${2##*/}" = "$2" && test -f "$w/$2" && test ! -L "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1 && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && sudo rm -- "$1"; }; h=/usr/local/sbin/ll-rpm-fixture; f=/opt/learning-lab/rpm-fixtures; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && fresh "$w/before.json" && sudo "$h" status > before.json && grep -F '"fixtures": {}' before.json && fresh "$w/before-raw.tsv" && timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{EPOCHNUM}\t%{VERSION}\t%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\n' > before-raw.tsv && fresh "$w/before.tsv" && LC_ALL=C sort before-raw.tsv > before.tsv && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this private path and shell definitions. A guard failure stops the exercise; do not continue over existing fixtures. Resume requires recorded path/definitions, not replaying setup.
steps.expected: Fixture-free package baseline retained without masking query failure.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/requires.txt" && rpm -qpR "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > requires.txt && cat requires.txt
steps.explanation: Inspect the exact version requirement before a root-context transaction test.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here || return 19; fresh "$w/dependency.txt" || return 19; if timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -i --test "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > dependency.txt 2>&1; then return 1; else rc=$?; test "$rc" = 1 && grep -F "ll-rpm-data = 2.0-1 is needed" dependency.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: --test reports an unsatisfied dependency without installation. This lesson does not apply raw rpm installs or use force/nodeps. An unrelated failure is not evidence.
steps.expected: Specific dependency refusal; no package changes.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here && fresh "$w/install-refused.txt" || return 19; if timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -i "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > install-refused.txt 2>&1; then return 1; else test $? = 1 && grep -F "ll-rpm-data = 2.0-1 is needed" install-refused.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: For this exact inspected script-free archive with both fixtures absent, observe actual installation refusal in the same sudo context as --test. Do not use force or nodeps. The final package comparison must still match.
steps.expected: Actual dependency refusal, not merely a simulated plan; no applied fixture.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/plan.txt" && sudo "$h" preview pair > plan.txt && cat plan.txt
steps.explanation: Resolve both explicit archives through the fixed frontend; this previews without applying.
